ja373:1.1: Kuhiṃ gatā kattha gatā iti lālappatī jano, aham eva eko jānāmi: udapāne Mūsikā hatā ti
ja373:2.1: Yath' etaṃ iti c' īti ca gadrabho va nivattasi, udapāne Mūsikaṃ hantvā yavaṃ bhakkhetum icchasīti
ja373:3.1: Daharo c' asi dummedha paṭhamuppattito susu, dīgham etaṃ samāsajja na te dassāmi jīvitan ti
ja373:4.1: Nāntalikkhabhavanena n' aṅgaputtasirena vā puttena hi patthayito silokehi pamocito.
ja373:5.1: Sabbaṃ sutam adhīyetha hīnamukkhaṭṭamajjhimaṃ, sabbassa attham jāneyya, na ca sabbaṃ payojaye, hoti tādisako kālo yattha atthāvahaṃ sutan ti.
